integration_handoff: Review owned files, run the 16 offline tests, then rerun read-only preflight on the current frozen manifest.
Keep baseline DB/message/log/.p4p_tmp files and JobId separate from freshly captured results.
Before running OS/CS, perform fresh GUI loading and generation, capture rewritten controls, and revalidate final effective inputs against one operation/one step/one local worker/no MPI/no remeshing.
Use an actual runtime supervisor with a 120-second deadline and cleanup restricted to trial-owned PIDs; metadata records a requirement and cannot enforce it.
Runtime invocation, version/hash attribution, reference comparisons and correct GUI reopen remain independent acceptance gates.
Known generated names are checked. Enforce the same strict path limit on every captured or newly planned dynamic name before launch.
Do not copy the large source yet; recheck free space including expected DB growth before later independent OL/CL preparation.
limitations: Static O2/C2 DEFORM-2D/GEOTYP1 evidence only, not GUI verification.
Existing large source is metadata-only inventory: 58 files, no content reads or large DB hashes.
No claim of runtime no-remesh behavior from preparation alone.
No end-to-end or token speedup measured; elapsed time is this local preflight invocation only.

independent_review_repair.finding: XML Property dictionary discarded duplicate DTMAX/HeatingTime entries, allowing invalid-before-valid control ambiguity.
independent_review_repair.correction: Require exactly one matching property and exactly one Value for each DTMAX=0.1 and HeatingTime=0.1 sec. Reject duplicate properties regardless of ordering or equality.
